name: code-editor-improvements-v1
description: Configuration for the Ko-Lab code editor IDE-like UI overhaul

changes.description: Replaced horizontal file list with a VS Code-style left sidebar containing an expandable/collapsible file tree

features: Folders sorted first, then files alphabetically
Auto-expand parent folders when a file is selected

changes.description: Added file type icons with color coding for all supported languages
Restructured the entire editor layout to a proper IDE layout with sidebar, tabs, and editor panel

main_content_sections: Top toolbar: file path, live URL editor, save/change-request buttons, edited indicator
Tab bar: horizontal scrolling tabs for open files with file-type icons and close button on hover
Code editor: CodeMirror filling remaining space with enhanced basicSetup options
Bottom actions moved into toolbar for streamlined UI

changes.description: Enabled additional CodeMirror features for a better editing experience
Added ability to close open tabs with a close button (X) that appears on hover

details.behavior: Closing a tab removes it from openFiles. If the closed tab was active, switches to the last remaining open tab.
details.no_tab_message: Shows 'Select a file to open' when no files are open

notes: All existing functionality preserved: Save Changes, Change Request, Live URL, Generate AI README
No external dependencies added beyond what was already in package.json
